introduction.instruction: Generate THREE independent Chinese public story candidates for the selected category in a single JSON candidates array. Each candidate is a complete alternative game, not a chapter or location in a common world. Give the three alternatives substantially different eras, social environments, everyday activities, central disputes and kinds of target objects. Invent these freely; no setting catalogue or shared fictional universe is prescribed. Chinese is the presentation language, not a restriction on culture, region or historical period. Build each premise from a specific human dilemma and choose a setting that makes it interesting. Category sets the intended experience. The runtime will select one candidate at random; give each equal creative attention. Do not select, rank or review candidates yourself. For EACH alternative: exactly three participants including one human-controlled role, three accessible locations, one portable recoverable item, a plausible deadline, and public stakes that make finding and returning that item matter. Respect the supported public mechanics. No gameplay has occurred. Leave choices and outcomes open. Do not disclose hidden custody, a culprit, private motives, future actions or an ending. Write a concise public introduction of 120–180 Chinese characters, then a title and item_name. Use natural Chinese and in-world names; keep IDs, variable placeholders, creativity_seed and implementation annotations out of player-facing prose. Return exactly three objects with introduction, title and item_name. Use valid JSON with ASCII double quotes as delimiters.

initial_setup.instruction: Create a consistent initial setup matching the confirmed public introduction. Use exactly roles A (human), B and C (AI), locations hall/study/courtyard, and one recoverable item. A begins in hall and wants to bring the item to hall. Choose actual starting custody from B,C,drawer; only its actual holder necessarily knows custody. Generate distinct personas, private goals, personal memories, and directional relationships. Do not give A the hidden custody or another role's private objective. Do not prescribe any per-beat action schedule. Private goals must be achievable using the supported choices, including disclosure, concealment, cooperation, movement, and private conversation. The item stays sealed unless a supported action says otherwise. The top-level JSON object must have exactly four sibling keys: rooms, item, custody, roles. roles contains exactly A, B, C and must be CLOSED before the next top-level key. All braces must balance. Each role relationships maps only other role IDs. Do not add unsupported places or item-opening goals; any past-place reference is a memory, not a playable location. Make the initial item holder capable of choosing cooperation or concealment using supported placement in the study drawer. Use natural in-world names in player-visible room/item/character labels and descriptions, and in A's persona, goals, memories and relationship descriptions. Internal IDs belong in structured control keys and values, not in the briefing.

character.instruction: Portray only the actor in your frozen baseline. Decide from that actor's memories, goals, relationships and actually acquired observations. Choose exactly one allowed_choices id. Other roles' hidden intentions are absent and cannot be used. Generate optional in-character speech and a private thought. If must_speak or must_respond is true, speech must be nonempty. Invitation acceptance is your decision, never presumed. A private channel's speech goes only to that conversation. Do not speak as the DM or narrate success. question_to is A,B,C or null. Action attempts are validated later and can fail. Do not expose your private thought in outward speech unless your character intentionally chooses disclosure. In spoken dialogue use the actual in-world character and location names, without internal IDs or parameter annotations. Keep the required choice and addressee IDs in their structured fields.

action.instruction: Interpret the human's explicit action attempt from only their authorized input and allowed_choices. Return one existing choice id, or ask for clarification. Do not execute a tentative thought, choose a new strategy, control another participant, or claim success. For a compound or unsupported request, clarify which supported first step to take rather than inventing capabilities. Use natural in-world names in clarification shown to the human. Keep the executable choice ID in its structured field.

dm.instruction: Adjudicate the supplied actual occurrences and utterances internally. Assess claims using actual records AND the speaker's acquired information: false but sincerely believed is mistaken, not known deception; missing evidence is uncertain. source_ids must reference provided actual event IDs. Only use supported cue codes pause,fingers,gaze, at most one per speaker. Cues become actual behavior; their internal reason/verdict is never delivered. Do not rewrite words, add a confession, expose hidden motives, create substantive actions, or turn the DM into a fictional speaker. Cues may reflect genuine stress as well as supported contradiction, so a cue is not proof of lying. Emit empty arrays when no claim or cue is warranted. Each assessment must contain speech_event_id from the supplied utterances, its actual speaker ID, verdict and source_ids. verdict must be exactly one of: supported (the claim is supported by the supplied facts), known_contradiction (the claim contradicts facts known to the speaker), mistaken (the claim is false but consistent with the speaker's belief), uncertain (the supplied evidence does not settle it). Use supported for a supported factual claim; do not output true, truthful, false or lying. A contradiction alone does not establish knowing deception. source_ids may contain only supplied actual event IDs. Each cue must contain speech_event_id from the supplied utterances, that utterance's speaker ID and one supported cue code. Return assessments and cues arrays, including empty arrays when appropriate.

private_dm.instruction: You are the dedicated DM for this one accepted private conversation, outside the fiction. Use its frozen participant baseline and subsequent private exchanges, plus only relevant adjudication facts. Follow the same claim and cue rules as the main DM: false belief is not deception, uncertainty stays uncertain, no verdict or hidden reason is shown. Do not forward outside events, the partner's private thoughts, or unrelated public history to participants. Preserve utterances exactly. Supported cue codes are pause,fingers,gaze; at most one per speaker. source_ids refer only to supplied event IDs. Each assessment must contain speech_event_id from the supplied utterances, its actual speaker ID, verdict and source_ids. verdict must be exactly one of: supported (the claim is supported by the supplied facts), known_contradiction (the claim contradicts facts known to the speaker), mistaken (the claim is false but consistent with the speaker's belief), uncertain (the supplied evidence does not settle it). Use supported for a supported factual claim; do not output true, truthful, false or lying. A contradiction alone does not establish knowing deception. source_ids may contain only supplied actual event IDs. Each cue must contain speech_event_id from the supplied utterances, that utterance's speaker ID and one supported cue code. Return assessments and cues arrays, including empty arrays when appropriate.

memory.instruction: Update only this character's private interpretation from the supplied acquired observations and previous summary. Write a concise memory summary; do not assert unseen history as observed. A relationship change must cite one or more supplied observation IDs that this character received. trust_delta is between -0.2 and 0.2. Keep changes small and grounded; no change is needed without evidence. For A, summarize acquired events without deciding the human's future actions or private intentions. A source can be a heard false account, which remains an account rather than verified truth. Keep summary below 240 Chinese characters: consolidate key beliefs instead of repeating a full transcript. Cite at most 6 summary source IDs. relationships MUST be a JSON array, not a role-keyed object; use [] when nothing changes. Each relationship reason is at most 80 Chinese characters and cites at most 3 acquired observation IDs. Do not emit a zero-change relationship entry without evidence. In A's player-visible memory summary and relationship reasons, use natural Chinese and in-world names. Keep source and target IDs in structured fields.

world_event.instruction: Select one eligible world event id, including none, based on current conditions. Do not invent a new event, clue, culprit, backup, or past fact. Choose none when an event adds no meaningful opportunity. These are current supported changes, not a way to force a desired ending.

ending.instruction: Generate the human character's personal ending from the supplied actual outcome and their acquired observations. Keep the runtime outcome unchanged. source_ids must be supplied observation IDs. Describe what they achieved, missed, or remain uncertain about without exposing hidden motives, private conversations they missed, unseen custody changes, or a full omniscient truth. Do not invent a confession or new evidence. This is their grounded perspective, not a forced solution. Your output MUST contain exactly title, narrative, source_ids. source_ids is REQUIRED, even when empty; list only actual supplied observation IDs supporting the narrative. Never omit this field. Describe the supplied actual_outcome, not a different result. Use natural Chinese and in-world names in the player-visible title and narrative. Keep observation IDs only in source_ids.

review.instruction: Select at most four unique observation IDs from the supplied acquired records. Do not generate facts, action advice, or hidden explanations. The runtime displays the original records.

case_introduction.instruction: Write THREE independent Chinese public murder-mystery premises, one for each supplied candidate_rosters entry, in exactly that order. Each roster already has FOUR LIVING named participants A/B/C/D and a FIFTH SEPARATE dead victim. Do not assign or return names: use those exact names in the premise. A is the human but has a proper name; never call another role "you". Each case needs its own contemporary indoor workplace/social environment and a distinctive conflict. No fixed fictional universe or recurring setting. The four living participants are still alive when the named victim is found dead. Introduce uncertainty, not the killer, answer, hidden motive, future ending or the camera-clock puzzle. Do not assign a murder method, outage, broken footage, missing person or an impossible locked-room condition. The facility can have three adjacent accessible rooms and ordinary preserved recordings. No fixed act count or investigation deadline. Each introduction is 100-160 Chinese characters. Return only title and introduction for each of the three candidates; code attaches its already-fixed roster. Use natural in-world names, no control IDs, placeholders or implementation explanations.

case_setup.instruction:
Author the social story and four personal profiles for the supplied fixed murder contract. This is deliberately a bounded, rule-defined mystery; you do not invent its mechanics. There are five named people: four living roles contract.cast and the separate dead victim. Keep all exact name mappings. The assigned culprit is contract.killer_name. A is the human, with partial knowledge; other roles must not know the culprit. Give concrete personal ties, contrasting attitudes, credible motives and an innocent private concern.
MECHANICAL FACTS: The killer alone directly strangled the victim with a thin cord in room r2 at contract.crime_time. All other AI suspects have continuous video alibis throughout contract.window_text. The death was discovered by A at the upper bound. Only one entrance leads to r2; complete entrance records exclude outsiders. The entrance camera's displayed clock has a fixed calibration discrepancy, resolved by maintenance records; other records use a master clock. These facts and all physical clues are constructed by rules before play; never invent an alternative cause, accomplice, accident, missing footage, forged footage, poison, delay mechanism or an off-screen proof. The killer may give a knowingly false cover_story; never put that account in an innocent's profile as fact.
Return format=bounded-v1, title, public_briefing, victim, rooms, conflict, innocent_secret, roles. Rooms exactly r1/r2/r3 are adjacent accessible areas inside the same contemporary facility, with natural names and concise descriptions that agree with the mechanism. r1 is a shared area, r2 the death scene, r3 a work/equipment area. public_briefing states the discovered death, personal stakes and ability to examine preserved records; it must not reveal the culprit, clock discrepancy or solution.
conflict contains truth,title,target,observation: a specific pre-crime conflict between the assigned killer and victim, plus an inspectable original document whose actual text substantiates that conflict. Do not make motive itself prove the murder. innocent_secret has the same fields for the actor assigned to contract.records.innocent_secret. It happened BEFORE the death window and did not require leaving during the alibi. Its discoverable document makes that actor look suspicious but has an innocent-of-murder explanation. No new witnesses or unsupplied physical facts are needed to understand either document.
roles has exactly A/B/C/D; each profile has name,persona,goal,cover_story,relationships (exactly three strings in the alphabetical order of the OTHER roles: A has B/C/D, B has A/C/D, C has A/B/D, D has A/B/C). A and innocents cannot know the killer or its hidden plan. Each AI will later decide freely how to act and speak. Do not predetermine future cooperation, confession, accusation or ending. Keep profile fields under 100 Chinese characters each, story/document fields under 200, descriptions under 100. No memories or evidence arrays: runtime derives personal experiences and physical evidence from the contract. Use proper character names in prose, never control IDs or placeholders.

case_character.instruction: Portray only the supplied character using its frozen personal experiences and acquired evidence/observations. Respond to the actual latest question or presented record concretely. Preserve prior statements; if challenged you may explain, evade, admit a limited secret or revise a belief according to your goals. A killer may lie; an innocent may conceal an unrelated secret. Do not invent actual past events, new witnesses, new physical evidence or a convenient confession. Speculation and claims are dialogue, not changes to history. Choose ONE exact ID from choices; your chosen inspect/move/share/invite/accept/decline/end_private is executed, so use it deliberately. A pending invitation needs a meaningful consent/refusal choice. Do not output an action as completed merely because you mention it. Speech is natural Chinese with in-world names, without control IDs. The memory summary uses only this role's acquired experience and preserves important contradictions; memory_sources may reference supplied observation IDs, this role's initial experienced_fact IDs, or acquired evidence IDs; never another role's unknown history. trust_delta is -0.2 to 0.2 relative to the human; suspect is A/B/C/D or null and is a private belief, not an omniscient answer. evidence_ids are only evidence you actually acquired. question_to is one of the permitted recipients or null. A question addressed to you requires a spoken response. Keep speech concise (typically 40-120 Chinese characters) and memory under 250 characters. Do not print private thoughts, secrets you choose to conceal, or any DM verdict.

case_dm.instruction: You are the external game DM for this one channel. Use fixed actual history and speaker knowledge to assess ONLY the supplied utterances. Return internal assessments with event_id and exactly one verdict: supported (facts support it), known_contradiction (contradicts facts the speaker knows), mistaken (false but consistent with their belief), uncertain (insufficient evidence). Opinions and suspicions are uncertain. Do not reveal judgments, force confession or alter speech. Optionally choose at most two observable cues from pause,gaze attached to actual supplied utterance event_ids. A cue does not prove lying; sincere stress can have the same cue. Use empty arrays if nothing warrants assessment or a cue. Do not invent extra events or instructions. Private conversation handling uses its own immutable participant baseline; outside utterances are absent.

case_memory.instruction: Summarize only this human character's acquired observations and optional private thoughts. Preserve the distinction between observed evidence, attributed statements and uncertain interpretations. Do not solve the case, invent evidence or send the thoughts to anyone else. Natural Chinese, under 250 Chinese characters.

case_action.instruction: Interpret the human's explicit attempted action using its authorized view. Return one exact supported choice ID, or null with a concise clarification. Thoughts, hypothetical plans and spoken claims are not performed actions. Never change strategy or invent a new effect. clarification is natural Chinese without internal identifiers.

case_theory.instruction:
Evaluate the player's FINAL accusation as ONE CONNECTED ARGUMENT. This is holistic reasoning assessment, NOT sentence classification. Read the entire explanation before deciding each aspect. Return at most ONE claim per aspect (identity, time, method); omit an aspect if no relevant argument exists.
identity asks: does the player actually explain WHY the accused person caused the lethal act, by connecting access, custody, recognition, opportunity or other supplied evidence to the act? Do not judge only the introductory "I accuse X" sentence when later sentences explain identity. An argument that only this person had opportunity in the death window is an IDENTITY argument, even though it mentions time. A custody/transfer chain identifying the actual user is also identity. A name alone or mere document list is unsupported.
time asks: does the player explain the supported death/action time boundary without turning the discovery time into an exact death time?
method asks: does the player connect the supplied physical evidence to the lethal mechanism and relevant misleading account?
Every claim has aspect, quote, supported and evidence_ids. quote is a nonempty EXACT CONTIGUOUS substring of explanation covering the relevant reasoning, and may span several sentences or paragraphs. supported is true only if the player's complete argument actually establishes that aspect using cited_evidence, consistent with the fixed solution. Never supply missing reasoning or new evidence on the player's behalf. A guessed name without a causal explanation remains unsupported.
Use IDs only from cited_evidence. Include all documents actually invoked in the connected argument for that aspect, including links explained elsewhere in the explanation. When proof_routes is present, it is a coverage aid containing already-cited candidate combinations, not permission to invent their interpretation. Check both the player's reasoning and its actual evidence use; do not blindly copy a route. Runtime separately checks culprit and sufficient evidence coverage. Recognize equivalent wording and cross-paragraph references. Empty claims is valid.

claims.quote: 玩家原文中的连续片段

case_ending.instruction: The investigation has ended by the player's explicit choice. Narrate the already adjudicated outcome in natural Chinese. established means supported reconstruction, unproven means correct suspect but insufficient submitted reasoning, incorrect means wrong suspect, unresolved means voluntary closure without accusation. Respect that result and the fixed solution/history. Explain how actual speech, disclosed evidence and recorded NPC beliefs/trust shaped the social outcome. Do not invent a confession, unanimous agreement or another ending. The final reveal is authorized now; explain misleading clues and innocent secrets from actual history, distinguish what the player discovered from the full case. Keep narrative around 250-450 Chinese characters, no implementation terminology or IDs.

ensemble_preview.instruction: Create exactly three independent public story premises for the supplied scenario and corresponding rosters. Use natural Chinese names from each roster. Vary the social institution, reason these people meet, conflicting interests and interpersonal stakes substantially across candidates. Four living participants, three accessible areas; the designated victim is an additional person only in murder. In murder, explicitly establish that this victim has been found dead and the participants are about to investigate. Cause, injuries, exact time, access/lock conditions, physical clues, deleted or damaged records, sightings and forensic results are not authored here. Do not invent an independent physical puzzle, a missing-person case, a rescue countdown, hidden culprit or future ending. Build interest through social conflict and unfinished commitments. Other scenarios follow their stated mechanics. Keep the setting independent of any preferred location or weather motif. No control IDs in prose.

ensemble_setup.instruction: Author the initial setting and social histories of the selected premise. Return title, briefing, rooms r1/r2/r3 and roles A/B/C/D. Bind all names to the supplied roster. Every role has persona, secret (a concrete actual social fact before play), secret_record (literal contents of an existing document supporting that secret), and three relationship descriptions for the other IDs in alphabetical order. Each persona has a distinct conversational habit and active stake; relationships explain a specific debt, loyalty, favor or disclosure tradeoff without dictating future choices. Relationships contain descriptions only, not repeated name headings. In murder the briefing MUST clearly say the designated victim has been found dead and investigation is starting. It may explain the social occasion and stakes, but no cause, exact time, injuries, sightings, locks, tampered/missing records or physical clues. Rooms describe neutral accessible layout, furnishings and usable equipment; do not add suspicious traces or extra puzzles. Physical facts and evidence are compiled separately and must not be invented here, even when a premise implied them. Do not determine the killer, alibis, physical visits, laboratory findings or future outcomes. Do not give a deadline forcing the ending. A secret document describes social history, never a forensic examination or a conflicting storage location. Use natural Chinese and reserve IDs for structural keys.

ensemble_opening.instruction: Portray this one role before the fictional murder opening. Decide whether this role is willing to kill the designated target based on its own persona, secret and relationships; this is a fictional choice, not a guaranteed outcome. Separately choose leave, inspect or touch if arriving to find a body. Return volunteer boolean and handling. Do not see or decide any other role choices.

ensemble_role.instruction:
Portray only this role, using its own initial experiences and acquired information. Return every top-level field in the example.
ACTION CONTRACT: Copy choice verbatim from the CURRENT choices array. An initial memory of a document, its title in an inspect option, or a signed fact does NOT make its evidence ID acquired. If only inspect:X is offered, inspect it first; never invent share:X. A physical action executes AFTER this turn's speech and reasoning; its new findings are only available on your next turn. evidence_ids must come from CURRENT evidence. memory_sources and relationship sources may use current observations, acquired evidence, initial experienced fact IDs or earlier memory.sources, at most 30 each. Never use choice IDs as sources.
Your two objectives guide behavior. Address focus.received_requests directly before changing subject: say what you admit, dispute or need to verify. Ask a specific question grounded in an acquired discrepancy, trade concrete information, protect a relationship or investigate an available lead. Avoid repeating focus.already_shared material or your recent action without a new reason. If no useful statement and no obligation exists, use empty speech and investigate; do not fill silence with generic promises. must_speak requires words; must_respond requires words or gesture. gesture is exactly null, 点头, 摇头 or 示意稍后回答; normally null when speaking.
conversation.listeners alone tells who hears now; question_to must be a current listener ID or null. Unavailable roles do not hear, owe no reply and acquire no outside history. Accepted private conversations continue within their own channel; use an offered accept/decline action for an invitation. The runtime announces that action once, so optional speech should add a reason or condition.
Outward speech serves your personality, loyalties and goals. Evasions and lies about your own conduct are permitted. Another character's claim is testimony, not established history. Do not invent authoritative test results, unobserved deeds or newly acquired evidence. Do not give unsolicited solution coaching. Use in-world Chinese names, usually 40-120 characters, no control IDs.
Keep reasoning as a PRIVATE cumulative argument about identity, time and method, under 600 Chinese characters. Separate it from tactical outward speech. Update it with acquired counterevidence; retain useful earlier deductions when answering an unrelated social question. suspect (A/B/C/D/null), evidence_ids and reasoning must agree as your private current position, with uncertainty retained. reasoning may be empty outside murder. It is not spoken or revealed to other characters. Keep memory under 200 Chinese characters, describing acquired experiences and uncertainty; a planned action is not an accomplished fact.
Relationships may be [] or at most three sourced directional updates. Every entry has target, trust_delta, affinity_delta, reason and sources. Each delta is within -0.2..0.2; sources is a nonempty array of actually acquired IDs; reason describes the acquired experience, not a forecast. Never know another role's private thought or unseen event.

ensemble_address.instruction: Identify which known cast character the human is actually addressing from their exact words and recent authorized conversation. Return that cast ID, or null for a general contribution. All cast names are known, but conversation.listeners alone identifies who can hear now. If the human clearly addresses a known unavailable character, keep that intended target; the runtime records that they did not hear it, without delivering anything outside the channel. Never substitute another addressee, change the human words, infer a physical action, or use an ID outside the supplied cast.

ensemble_action.instruction: Interpret only the explicit submitted action attempt using the human's authorized view. Return one exact choice ID or null with a short clarification. A private thought, hypothetical plan or claimed earlier success does not execute an action. Never change the human's strategy or invent unsupported physics. Use in-world names in clarification.

ensemble_memory.instruction: Summarize only this character's acquired experiences, previous memory and optional private thoughts. Preserve sources, earlier contradictions and uncertainty; do not solve the case or expose others' hidden facts. This is scoped compaction, not rewriting authoritative history. sources must be supplied observation, evidence or initial fact IDs. Natural Chinese, under 220 characters. Merge the provided next chronological chunk into prior memory. Preserve useful earlier sources from memory.sources, rather than summarizing only the newest line. Authoritative evidence snapshots remain available separately.

ensemble_dm.instruction:
You are the external DM for exactly this channel, never a fictional participant. Assess only supplied utterances using fixed history, relevant actual events, the speaker's initial profile and experienced facts, AND each utterance's captured speaker_knowledge (acquired evidence, memory, beliefs and observations). Classify factual claims as supported, known_contradiction, mistaken or uncertain. A statement contrary to world truth is not necessarily a knowing lie: check what the speaker actually knows. Missing knowledge or uncertain interpretation stays uncertain. Preserve the speaker's original words exactly.
For each supplied utterance, consider whether a small observable microexpression or vocal detail adds something to this exchange. Use the content and its truth/knowledge assessment together with the speaker's persona, received challenge, conversational pressure, prior words and previously observed demeanor. You may attach at most one short cue per utterance; ordinary speech can have none. A deliberate lie can be composed, while a truthful or mistaken speaker can be tense. Never map a verdict to a fixed tell or make every lie visibly nervous. Vary details only when the context supports them; avoid repetitive theatrical reactions. Do not replace, extend or contradict an explicitly chosen spoken line or nonverbal action. Cues describe delivery only, never a new consequential action, involuntary confession, evidence, or another person's reaction.
Write each cue as one concise natural Chinese sentence, preferably within 40 Chinese characters, using the speaker's in-world name if a name is needed. Describe only something an observer could actually hear or see. Never include a truth label, the assessment, a hidden motive, secret knowledge, psychological explanation or causal wording that reveals why the speaker reacted. modality is audible for purely vocal/timing details, or visible for purely facial/gaze/posture details. Do not mix visual and audible details in one cue, because their eligible observers differ. The runtime delivers visible cues only to recipients at the speaker's utterance-time location; audible cues only to actual listeners. Do not invent a facial expression for an unheard remote speaker. Private history is scoped to this accepted conversation.
disclosures lists only already-acquired evidence or initial known fact IDs explicitly revealed in the actual words (event_id, evidence_id). Initial private facts such as secret_A are eligible only when the speaker knows them; merely mentioning a document without its contents is not disclosure.
Exact output: assessments is an array of objects with event_id and verdict (one literal string: supported, known_contradiction, mistaken, uncertain). cues is an array of objects with event_id, modality (audible or visible), and text (the observable Chinese sentence). disclosures is an array of objects with event_id and evidence_id. Every event_id must refer to a supplied utterance; at most one cue per event_id. Empty arrays are valid. No explanatory text outside the JSON.

ensemble_world.instruction: Choose one eligible world effect from choices, or none, based on the current opportunity and scenario. This choice changes current conditions only. Do not create a clue, reveal a culprit, alter past facts or force an ending. Prefer restoring blocked access if the interruption has served its purpose.

ensemble_ending.instruction: Write a short Chinese epilogue grounded in the frozen history, solution and actual events. Return title and narrative. closure.truth_established tells whether a sufficient shared conclusion was reached in play; distinguish that from the historical truth now revealed after closure. Describe the causal sequence and two or three actual choice consequences. The interface separately renders all personal and primary objective outcomes: do not narrate who won/lost, passed/failed or completed/failed a personal objective, and do not infer those scores from relationships. You have no individual result table. Do not invent confessions, future acts, punishments or consequences absent from the supplied records. Use natural character names; no control IDs. Keep narrative within 350 Chinese characters and avoid repeating the entire evidence catalogue. public_dialogue supplies recent literal public utterances as evidence of what people actually said. An admission of touching, lending or swapping an object is NOT a confession to killing. Do not say someone confessed, conceded an accusation or changed an account unless their exact supplied words do so. Evidence establishing guilt is not evidence of a confession. If no dialogue supports a reaction, narrate the physical reconstruction and recorded actions only. Private conversations remain outside this public recap.
